name: National Data Center (MPTC)
developer: Government of Cambodia / Ministry of Post and Telecommunications; NTT Data supporting
notes: Government-owned national data center in Phnom Penh (Digital Park pipeline). Groundbreaking July 2023; DCD/Khmer Times report $30m, 12-storey, Tier IV certification target (B claims). MPTC official page (A) confirms 2025-07-02 site visit by Minister Chea Vandeth, Japanese Ambassador and NTT Data (Asia-Pacific/Global DC Japan/Data Inc) reps with Tier IV standard stated; Japan grant aid up to ~$16m per DCD. Launch targeted 2025 per Knight Frank Dec 2024; ~3 MW reported in some market sources but unverified so capacity kept null.

name: ByteDC Data Center (Phnom Penh City Center / PPCC)
developer: ByteDC Solutions / Urban Data Center Co., Ltd (Bytedc (KH) Co., Ltd)
notes: Cambodia's first Uptime Tier III certified (design) carrier-neutral data center, inaugurated 2023-05-11. Up to 3 MW IT capacity (DCD, B), ~81,040 sq ft built-up floor space, ~1,000 racks, at Phnom Penh City Center (Land 356 Street R-4, Srah Chork, Daun Penh). Uptime award record (A) for facility identity; capacity claim per DCD/trade press.

name: Chaktomuk Data Center PNH1
notes: Cambodia's first/only Tier III Plus Design-certified carrier-neutral data center per official site and Uptime award (design certification, not operational certification). Central Phnom Penh, corner Street 598 / St 777 (Knight Frank report places it in Russey Keo District near Camko City). Capacity not published.

name: Telcotech / Royal Group Elite DC1
notes: Royal Group carrier-neutral telecom/data center operator with 30,000 km fiber network and AAG/MCT submarine cable interests. Official Telcotech page reports Royal Group Elite DC1 achieved Uptime Institute Tier III certification (2025 announcement); treat as Tier III certified design/operation claim per operator (A) - capacity not published.

name: Telcotech Kampus Data Center
notes: CDC approved 2023-10-18: ~US$27.7M investment, 47 jobs, at Kampus Building, Monivong Blvd, Sangkat Tonle Bassac, Khan Chamkarmon, Phnom Penh (Construction & Property, B). Keystone Cable supplier project page indicates Telcotech signed lease for the Kampus data center (development proceeding). Not yet reported operational; status approved/under development.

name: Kepstar DC1
developer: Kepstar Data Centre Management Co., Ltd
notes: Inaugural Kepstar facility at 216 Norodom Blvd, Phnom Penh; W.Media (Nov 2022) reported Kepstar launching 'Cambodia's 1st Tier III data center'. Company profile (DataCenterMap, B/C) describes first phase of a pair of carrier-neutral DCs with combined ~6.8 MW and 1,200 racks in 110,000 sq ft. Baxtel lists Kepstar Phnom Penh ~7 MW (C). DC2 site ~100 km from Phnom Penh, province not confirmed.

name: Kepstar consortium 'Cambodia's largest data center' (Te Aikhong + Kepstar + Fourtitude Asia)
developer: JV of Te Aikhong Enterprise, Kepstar Data Center, Fourtitude Asia
notes: June 2018 MoU for a $70M facility 'near Phnom Penh' with construction claimed to begin that month (DCD citing Khmer Times). No later public evidence found that this specific facility was built; treat as planned/intent (C). Location province unspecified; DCD tags Phnom Penh.

name: SINET Data Centre
notes: Phnom Penh-headquartered specialist ISP/enterprise network operator with data centre service; ~3,000 m2 Phnom Penh data centre per consultant project page (Archetype, methodology ref, B). SINET peers at Chaktomuk data center (PeeringDB AS59318). MW not public.

name: MekongNet IDC1 (SunCity Building)
developer: MekongNet / Angkor Data Communication Group Co., Ltd
notes: One of two MekongNet IDC facilities in Phnom Penh, at SunCity Building, Street 370. Official MekongNet data-center service page confirms colocation/hosting/IDC service; MW not published.

name: MekongNet IDC2 (AnAnA Building)
developer: MekongNet / Angkor Data Communication Group Co., Ltd
notes: Second MekongNet IDC at AnAnA Building, 95 Preah Norodom Blvd, Phnom Penh (whtop review, C/B). Inflect directory lists 120 kW power capacity (C-grade directory evidence); operator does not publish MW.

name: Seatel Cloud Data Center
developer: Seatel / South East Asia Telecom (yes Seatel)
notes: Seatel (formerly Yes Telecom) cloud/data-centre colocation in Phnom Penh, ~8 km from the international airport per marketing video/ad (C). ~2 MW figure is directory-derived (Baxtel/market reports, C) and not confirmed by the operator; capacity treated as unverified.

name: Daun Penh Data Center (DPDC)
developer: Daun Penh Data Center Co., Ltd (Daun Penh Group)
notes: Colocation/hosting/VPS/cloud provider at Hun Sen Boulevard, Phnom Penh (Daun Penh Group); design/office+DC project page dated 2024 (theroomds.com); AS152301 registered (IPinfo). Facility-level capacity not public; graded C until official site or certification evidence.

name: HTN-IDC (HT Networks)
notes: Small colocation facility at No. 33-34 St 114, Sangkat Monorom, Khan 7 Makara, Phnom Penh (DataCenterMap, C); also associated with HTN-CIX Cambodia Internet Exchange; capacity not public.

name: Ezecom Data Centre
notes: Major Phnom Penh fiber/ISP/cloud provider offering colocation, cloud hosting and data centre services (EuroCham member profile, B; whtop review). Facility-level details/MW sparse; cross-check TRC operator presence; do not double-count with Telcotech/Royal Group facilities.
